sentences.text:
Author: U. Durga Prasad Rao
Bench: U. Durga Prasad Rao
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice U. Durga Prasad Rao
 Criminal Petition No.5059 Of 2019
Order:

The petitioner/A5 seeks to quash the proceedings against him in Crime No.190 of 2019 of Thulluru Police Station, Guntur District, registered for the offences under Sections 270, 273, 328 and 420 of IPC and Sections 56, 57 and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act (for short, 'FSS Act').
2.

The allegations against the petitioner briefly are that on 23.06.2019, when the complainant along with his staff conducting search at outskirts of Lingayapalem Village, Seed Access Road, on suspicion, caught the accused and found the banned tobacco products in their possession and hence,
seized the same and registered a case in Crime No.190 of 2019 of Thulluru Police Station, for the offences stated supra.
3.

Learned counsel for petitioner while denying the FIR allegations would submit that even if the prosecution case is accepted to be true, tobacco products would not fall within the definition of Section 3(j) of FSS Act and therefore, the Police are not authorized to register the crime, investigate and file charge sheet and therefore, registration of the FIR is contrary to the provisions of FSS Act.
He relied upon the order of this Court in Crl.P.Nos.3731 of 2018 and batch, dated 27.08.2018.
As can be seen, in the said common order a learned Judge of this Court partly allowed the criminal petitions and quashed the offences punishable under Indian Penal Code and FSS Act.

4. Following the above order and for the reasons recorded therein, this criminal petition is allowed and the proceedings initiated against the petitioner under Sections 270, 273, 328 and 420 of IPC and Sections 56, 57 and 63 of FSS Act are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, in this case shall stand closed.

_ U. DURGA PRASAD RAO, J 13.09.2019 SS Nanduri Hanumantha Rao vs State Of Ap on 13 September, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115480571/
